case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's location, sea and cliff views, gardens and breakfast, and some highlighted friendly staff and spacious accommodations with private outdoor areas. Several reviewers described issues with general maintenance and need for renovation, aging suites/kitchenettes and bedding, pool shortcomings (unclean, unheated or crowded), shower problems (cold or bathtub-shower) and worn sunbeds; opinions on room cleanliness and value for money were mixed.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.
